Alper Alacam  |  Naval Architect and Marine Engineer  |  Turkiye  |  2026
Polar operations combine structural ice loads, low-temperature performance, icing, navigation limits, remoteness, environmental protection and crew competence.
Polar category and certificate pathway; Polar Class register; POLARIS RIO arithmetic with user-supplied official RIVs; winterization; voyage planning; PWOM evidence and 2026 amendment awareness.

This workbook does not assign an ice class or operational permission. RIVs and ice concentrations must come from the current official POLARIS material and observed ice regime; class and Administration approval govern.
IMO Polar Code; January 2026 Polar Code supplement; IACS Polar Class Unified Requirements.

values: POLARIS RIO -- ARITHMETIC WITH OFFICIAL INPUTS
RIO = sum(C_i × RIV_i). Enter ice concentrations in tenths and RIVs from the current official POLARIS table for the ship’s assigned ice class.
Must equal 10 for a complete regime.
Concentrations and RIVs must be verified.
Use current POLARIS decision criteria and PWOM.
Sources and limits: POLARIS arithmetic only. No RIV table or go/no-go threshold is invented; use the current official guidance for assigned ice class.
